column1: # §4.7 — `/File Save` runs on a background tokio task. While the
# worker writes the xlsx, mode is WAIT and control-panel line 3
# names the file being saved. On completion mode pops back to
# READY and the file appears on disk.
# Park the next async op so the transcript can observe the
# pre-spawn WAIT frame the way the production renderer does.
# /FS <path><ENTER> queues the save and returns immediately.
# Mid-flight: WAIT indicator visible, line 3 names the file, and
# the file hasn't been written yet (worker is parked).
# Drain the parked op to completion.
# Mode pops back to READY and the file is on disk.
